narr: A closed upper-level low moved across southeastern Colorado/southwestern Kansas on the 22nd. With increasing mid-level ascent, widespread showers and thunderstorms developed across the WFO Norman Forecast Area. Owing to meager instability, emerging convection was generally non-severe, though two stronger storms (producing wind damage) occurred in central Oklahoma and western-north Texas during the day. Localized flooding was also observed in the community of Norman, Oklahoma.
